utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up steam; I can swing by later and drop off what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine. I’ll be around after lunch, so drop it by then and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, I’ll bring it by after lunch and let you know when I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring the drill and a set of screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll bring the drill and screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think so, but I’d double-check the timing and who’s bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but only if someone confirms the time and brings the tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I meant to bring my gloves, but I probably left them by the door again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a spare pair in the crate by the steps if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, I might take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Do we know what kind of repair supplies Noah still needs?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think I still need some basic patching stuff... tape, maybe screws? I missed the list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think you still need tape and screws, right? I can check the full list if you want.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m here now, if you still need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks. Could you help me check the motor and the battery pack?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely, I’ll check both right now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can swing by and help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A hammer, a box of nails, and a pry bar would help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve got it — I’ll bring those three things over.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can track where it’s headed if you tell me the first stop on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: The first stop is the school gym. I’ll let you know the rest after that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll keep track of the next stops if you share them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up again this afternoon. Folks around here have been dropping off tools and donations all morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I should swing by later and see if they still need help, and I’ll tell a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That would be a big help, Quinn. They were saying they might need extra hands sorting things by late afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It starts at 10 a.m., I think.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, should I plan to be there a little before 10?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. I’ll repeat the plan to the others and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Good to hear. I’ll go with whatever update you pass along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll pass the update along and keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli, I’ve got the repair drive organized and I’m keeping the list updated as people confirm. What can you take on?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can handle sorting and loading the smaller repairs. Just tell me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, that helps a lot. Start with the smaller repairs on the east side, and I’ll send you the list with addresses and pickup order.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping off tools and a few donations this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds like it’s still going steady. I’ll come by this afternoon and see if there’s anything left to sort.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like it’s moving along. I’ll keep an ear out in case they need an extra hand this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Just a few items left: sorting the donated parts and checking who can handle the porch wiring. I can keep coordinating the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can take the porch wiring if you want, and I’ll help sort the donated parts after that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you want. What’s still left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Just the wiring and the side door latch, mostly. I can handle the latch, if you don’t mind taking a look at the wiring.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d bring the Phillips screwdriver and the spare screws, and meet you by the garage at six.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll bring those and be by the garage at six.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with that repair drive if you want — I’m happy to connect people or pass along details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Can you send me the specific details first so I make sure I pass them along accurately?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details now so you can pass them along accurately.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest change, so just tell me what I need to bring.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, I’m on my way. Just tell me what to bring and where to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re sending the repair drive around this afternoon. I’m heading past the shop anyway, so I can check what they’re taking.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can ask them what’s being prioritized, so we know whether it’s tools, parts, or just a pickup list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Leo — tell me what needs fixing and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, just send me the repair list and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, I’ll send over the repair list now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a little worried about the timing and who’s covering the pickup, but I can help if we keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can take the pickup if we set the time now. What slot works for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let’s aim for a slot that gives us enough buffer for pickup and drop-off, maybe late morning. If you can do the pickup, I’ll handle the rest as long as we lock the time in now.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive already. Want me to put your name down too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, put my name down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ve got you down. I’ll let you know once I’ve got the full list together.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need the time and place for the repair drive first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry, I forgot the details. I’m checking the time and place now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, send me the time and place when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Nell. I’ve got the repair drive list organized, and I’ll make sure we cover the most urgent fixes first.
